The '''Void Strider''' was a type of creature that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], where they would run around the [[Desert/Legends|desert]], looking for [[Water/Legends|water]].

==History==
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]], after separating from the other members of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], jumped onto these creatures and rode them to the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], where the other members of D-Squad had already arrived.
